title: Książ stable ensemble
visualBrief: Open stable quadrangle with five distinct ranges, arched gate tower, carriage-house bays, red mansard residence tower, cream administration gable, timber framing and the separate covered riding hall with connecting annexes.

nativeAxes.origin: Own stable quadrangle envelope center; Y0 estimated shared contact datum

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: Own named stable ensemble, NID A/4631/655/WŁ. Exterior identities follow the numbered 2005 primary monograph plan and photographs, plus the operator aerial. One connected source asset represents the ranges; these are not five separately surveyed footprints.

reconstruction.basis: Own attributed connected stable footprint, separately mapped adjacent hall complex, 2005 labeled primary monograph plan and photographs, plus present operator aerial.
reconstruction.scope: One exterior ensemble asset: all five stable ranges, carriage-house range, open gate tower, residence tower, administration, rounded former canteen and covered riding hall with attached ranges. No horse/carriage collections, interiors, garden layout, adjoining houses or parent castle geometry.
reconstruction.registration: Map-based anchor/axis, interpreted facade/part positions and estimated shared Y0. Activation remains pending terrain and component-association review.

geographicProposal.notes: Own connected stable outline and adjacent riding-hall outline; named semantic parts follow the primary plan. Facade bays, boundaries, heights and shared datum are proposed. Inactive until component/terrain fit reviewed.
